note: The only boundary between the desktop app (tools, DB, permissions) and agent-service (LLM, prompts, policy). Messages use the OpenAI chat format.
endpoint: POST /v1/turn (header x-agent-token when AGENT_TOKEN is set), GET /health

request.messages: [{role: user|assistant|tool, content, tool_calls?, tool_call_id?}] - no system role; the service adds its own prompt
request.tools: [{name, description, parameters (JSON schema)}] - only tools the current user may use in the current sector
request.step: 0-based loop index; the service offers no tools on its last step
request.llm: {apiUrl, apiKey, model} optional - the desktop AI settings; falls back to the service env

response.tool_calls: {type: 'tool_calls', calls: [{id, name, args, badArgs?}], message: <assistant message to append verbatim>}

errors: non-2xx with {error: <arabic message>}: 400 bad request, 401 token, 413 body, 502 LLM failure, 503 LLM not configured
rules: The service never touches the database; tool results come back as role=tool messages.
Write tools (write:true in electron/services/agent/tools.js) never execute from a model call; they become a proposal the user confirms.
